name: agents-progress
description: Progress bar above the prompt for delegated work, plus an agents panel (/agents-info) that opens for any subagent: running, finished and planned subagents with model, task progress, context, cost and time.

language.title: Panel language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale

stepBrief.title: Brief subagents to report steps
stepBrief.description: on adds a paragraph to every subagent's prompt, a workflow's agents included, asking it to report its steps, so the panel shows each task's own progress; agents leaves a workflow's agents out; off leaves prompts as written

heavyEffort.title: Run heavy tasks at xhigh effort
heavyEffort.description: on runs every subagent of a task planned heavy at xhigh effort, above CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_EFFORT and the session's level; off leaves its effort as Claude Code picks it
